title: छोरीले कोर्ट म्यारिज गरेपछि धनुषाका रास्वपा सभापतिले दिए ‘हराएको’ निवेदन, एसपीलाई गालीगलौज (भिडिओ)
content:
No ads found for this position जनकपुरधाम । छोरीले कोर्ट म्यारिज गरेपछि रन्थनिएका रास्वपाका धनुषा जिल्ला सभापति लक्ष्मेश्वर यादवले प्रहरीमाथि रिस पोखेका छन् । प्रहरीले छोरीको विवाह छुटाउन सहयोग नगरेकोमा असन्तुष्ट भएका उनले सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा नै जिल्ला प्रहरी प्रमुखमाथि अनेक लाञ्छना लगाए । आइतबार पार्टीले आयोजना गरेको शुभकामना आदानप्रदान कार्यक्रममा उनले एसपी रुपेश खड्कालाई ‘घुसखोर’, ‘दलाल’ जस्ता शब्द प्रयोग गर्दै गालीगलौज गरेका हुन् । कार्यक्रममा धनुषा क्षेत्र नम्बर २ का सांसद रामविनोद यादव, धनुषा क्षेत्र नम्बर ३ बाट सांसद मनिष झालगायत रास्वपाका नेता तथा कार्यकर्ताहरूको उपस्थिति थियो । कार्यक्रमको भिडियोमा सभापति यादव प्रहरी प्रमुखमाथि खनिइरहँदा उपस्थित नेता–कार्यकर्ताले ताली बजाइरहेको र सांसद झा हाँसिरहेको देखिन्छ । नेपाल प्रेससँग कुरा गर्दै सभापति यादवले आफूले प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा नदेखे पनि सामान्य झगडाका घटनामा आर्थिक लेनदेन गरेर प्रहरीले मुद्दा दर्ता गर्ने गरेको आरोप लगाए । यस्ता घटनाबारे आफूलाई दर्जनौँ व्यक्तिले जानकारी दिएको उनको दाबी छ । ‘घरायसी झगडामा समेत ज्यान मार्ने उद्योगमा मुद्दा दर्ता गरिएको भनेर मलाई कार्यकर्ताहरूले गुनासो गरिरहेका छन्,’ उनले भने । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय धनुषाका प्रमुख एसपी खड्काले मंगलबार प्रेस विज्ञप्ति जारी गर्दै यादवको अभिव्यक्तिप्रति आपत्ति जनाएका छन् । आफू र प्रहरी कार्यालयको नाम जोडेर लगाइएका आरोप आपत्तिजनक, भ्रामक र तथ्यहीन रहेको उनको भनाइ छ । के हो विवाहको विवाद ? प्रहरीका अनुसार हंसपुर नगरपालिका–८, भतही टोलका ५६ वर्षीय यादवले आफ्नी पारिवारिक महिला सदस्य हराएको भन्दै २०८३ असोज १७ गते जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयमा खोजतलासका लागि निवेदन दिएका थिए । तर, प्रहरीले बुझ्दा ती महिला हराएको नभई कोर्ट म्यारिज गरेर हिँडेको पाइयो । काठमाडौँ जिल्ला अदालतबाट असोज ८ गते नै विवाहको नाता कायम गराइसकेको र असोज १४ गते आफ्नो पतिसँग गएको खुलेको प्रहरीको विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ । प्रहरीले दुई पक्षलाई प्रत्यक्ष कुराकानी गराउनुका साथै विवाहसम्बन्धी प्रमाण देखाएर वास्तविक अवस्थाबारे यादवलाई जानकारी गराएको थियो । तर, आफ्नो मञ्जुरीबिना विवाह भएको भन्दै यादवले सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिहरूलाई पक्राउ गरी जबर्जस्ती छुटाइदिन दबाब दिएका हुन् । प्रहरीका अनुसार यादवकी छोरीले गरेको विवाह कानूनतः वैध छ । केटी २७ वर्षकी र केटा २३ वर्षका हुन् । जात नमिलेको र केटाको आर्थिक स्तर कमजोर रहेकाले यादवले स्वीकार नगरेको बुझिएको छ । उनले हजारौँ मानिस ल्याएर जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय घेराउ गर्ने धम्की दिएको र त्यसपछि सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा प्रहरी प्रमुखमाथि आरोप लगाएको विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ । एसपी खड्काले आफूविरुद्ध लगाइएका आरोप पुष्टि गर्न चुनौती दिँदै अपुष्ट सामग्री सामाजिक सञ्जालमा शेयर नगर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । घटनाबारे प्रचलित कानुनबमोजिम अघि बढ्ने उनको भनाइ छ । स्रोतका अनुसार रास्वपा कार्यकर्ताहरुले एसपी खड्कालाई गैरकानुनी रुपमा काम गर्न दबाब दिदैँ आएको छ । तर एसपीले अस्वीकार गर्दा उनीहरु चिढिएको अवस्था छ । Janakpurdham. Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) Dhanusha District President Laxmeshwor Yadav, who was upset after his daughter got married in court, has vented his anger on the police. Dissatisfied with the police not helping to arrange his daughter's marriage, he leveled several insults at the District Police Chief at a public event. At a greeting exchange program organized by the party on Sunday, he abused SP Rupesh Khadka using words like 'intruder' and 'broker'. The program was attended by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) leaders and workers, including Dhanusha Constituency No. 2 MP Ram Binod Yadav and Dhanusha Constituency No. 3 MP Manish Jha. In the video of the program, while President Yadav is criticizing the police chief, the leaders and workers present are clapping and MP Jha is laughing. Speaking to Nepal Press, President Yadav alleged that the police are registering cases based on financial transactions in ordinary disputes, even though he has not witnessed them directly. He claims that dozens of people have informed him about such incidents. "Activists are complaining to me that cases have been registered in the industry that even involve killings in domestic disputes," he said. SP Khadka, Chief of the District Police Office, Dhanusha, issued a press release on Tuesday expressing his objection to Yadav's statement. He said that the allegations made against him and the police office are objectionable, misleading and without facts. What is a marriage dispute? According to the police, 56-year-old Yadav of Bhatahi Tole, Hanspur Municipality-8, had filed a search application at the District Police Office on Asoj 17, 2083, claiming that his female family member was missing. However, when the police investigated, it was found that the woman was not missing but had left after a court marriage. The police statement states that the marriage was already formalized by the Kathmandu District Court on Asoj 20 and that she left with her husband on Asoj 25. The police had made the two parties talk directly and informed Yadav about the real situation by showing him evidence of the marriage. However, Yadav has pressured the relevant persons to arrest and forcibly release them, saying that the marriage took place without his consent. According to the police, the marriage of Yadav's daughter is legally valid. The girl is 27 years old and the boy is 23 years old. It is understood that Yadav did not accept it because of the caste mismatch and the boy's poor financial status. He threatened to bring thousands of people to surround the District Police Office and then made allegations against the police chief at a public event, the statement said. SP Khadka has challenged the police to confirm the allegations against him and urged them not to share unconfirmed content on social media. He said that the incident will be dealt with in accordance with the prevailing law. According to sources, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) workers have been pressuring SP Khadka to work illegally. But they are irritated when the SP refuses.

प्रहरीका अनुसार हंसपुर नगरपालिका–८, भतही टोलका ५६ वर्षीय यादवले आफ्नी पारिवारिक महिला सदस्य हराएको भन्दै २०८३ असोज १७ गते जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयमा खोजतलासका लागि निवेदन दिएका थिए । तर, प्रहरीले बुझ्दा ती महिला हराएको नभई कोर्ट म्यारिज गरेर हिँडेको पाइयो । काठमाडौँ जिल्ला अदालतबाट असोज ८ गते नै विवाहको नाता कायम गराइसकेको र असोज १४ गते आफ्नो पतिसँग गएको खुलेको प्रहरीको विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ । प्रहरीले दुई पक्षलाई प्रत्यक्ष कुराकानी गराउनुका साथै विवाहसम्बन्धी प्रमाण देखाएर वास्तविक अवस्थाबारे यादवलाई जानकारी गराएको थियो । तर, आफ्नो मञ्जुरीबिना विवाह भएको भन्दै यादवले सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिहरूलाई पक्राउ गरी जबर्जस्ती छुटाइदिन दबाब दिएका हुन् । प्रहरीका अनुसार यादवकी छोरीले गरेको विवाह कानूनतः वैध छ । केटी २७ वर्षकी र केटा २३ वर्षका हुन् । जात नमिलेको र केटाको आर्थिक स्तर कमजोर रहेकाले यादवले स्वीकार नगरेको बुझिएको छ । उनले हजारौँ मानिस ल्याएर जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय घेराउ गर्ने धम्की दिएको र त्यसपछि सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा प्रहरी प्रमुखमाथि आरोप लगाएको विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ । एसपी खड्काले आफूविरुद्ध लगाइएका आरोप पुष्टि गर्न चुनौती दिँदै अपुष्ट सामग्री सामाजिक सञ्जालमा शेयर नगर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । घटनाबारे प्रचलित कानुनबमोजिम अघि बढ्ने उनको भनाइ छ । स्रोतका अनुसार रास्वपा कार्यकर्ताहरुले एसपी खड्कालाई गैरकानुनी रुपमा काम गर्न दबाब दिदैँ आएको छ । तर एसपीले अस्वीकार गर्दा उनीहरु चिढिएको अवस्था छ । Janakpurdham. Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) Dhanusha District President Laxmeshwor Yadav, who was upset after his daughter got married in court, has vented his anger on the police. Dissatisfied with the police not helping to arrange his daughter's marriage, he leveled several insults at the District Police Chief at a public event. At a greeting exchange program organized by the party on Sunday, he abused SP Rupesh Khadka using words like 'intruder' and 'broker'. The program was attended by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) leaders and workers, including Dhanusha Constituency No. 2 MP Ram Binod Yadav and Dhanusha Constituency No. 3 MP Manish Jha. In the video of the program, while President Yadav is criticizing the police chief, the leaders and workers present are clapping and MP Jha is laughing. Speaking to Nepal Press, President Yadav alleged that the police are registering cases based on financial transactions in ordinary disputes, even though he has not witnessed them directly. He claims that dozens of people have informed him about such incidents. "Activists are complaining to me that cases have been registered in the industry that even involve killings in domestic disputes," he said. SP Khadka, Chief of the District Police Office, Dhanusha, issued a press release on Tuesday expressing his objection to Yadav's statement. He said that the allegations made against him and the police office are objectionable, misleading and without facts. What is a marriage dispute? According to the police, 56-year-old Yadav of Bhatahi Tole, Hanspur Municipality-8, had filed a search application at the District Police Office on Asoj 17, 2083, claiming that his female family member was missing. However, when the police investigated, it was found that the woman was not missing but had left after a court marriage. The police statement states that the marriage was already formalized by the Kathmandu District Court on Asoj 20 and that she left with her husband on Asoj 25. The police had made the two parties talk directly and informed Yadav about the real situation by showing him evidence of the marriage. However, Yadav has pressured the relevant persons to arrest and forcibly release them, saying that the marriage took place without his consent. According to the police, the marriage of Yadav's daughter is legally valid. The girl is 27 years old and the boy is 23 years old. It is understood that Yadav did not accept it because of the caste mismatch and the boy's poor financial status. He threatened to bring thousands of people to surround the District Police Office and then made allegations against the police chief at a public event, the statement said. SP Khadka has challenged the police to confirm the allegations against him and urged them not to share unconfirmed content on social media. He said that the incident will be dealt with in accordance with the prevailing law. According to sources, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) workers have been pressuring SP Khadka to work illegally. But they are irritated when the SP refuses.

The police had made the two parties talk directly and informed Yadav about the real situation by showing him evidence of the marriage. However, Yadav has pressured the relevant persons to arrest and forcibly release them, saying that the marriage took place without his consent. According to the police, the marriage of Yadav's daughter is legally valid. The girl is 27 years old and the boy is 23 years old. It is understood that Yadav did not accept it because of the caste mismatch and the boy's poor financial status. He threatened to bring thousands of people to surround the District Police Office and then made allegations against the police chief at a public event, the statement said. SP Khadka has challenged the police to confirm the allegations against him and urged them not to share unconfirmed content on social media. He said that the incident will be dealt with in accordance with the prevailing law. काठमाडौँ जिल्ला अदालतबाट असोज ८ गते नै विवाहको नाता कायम गराइसकेको र असोज १४ गते आफ्नो पतिसँग गएको खुलेको प्रहरीको विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ । प्रहरीले दुई पक्षलाई प्रत्यक्ष कुराकानी गराउनुका साथै विवाहसम्बन्धी प्रमाण देखाएर वास्तविक अवस्थाबारे यादवलाई जानकारी गराएको थियो । तर, आफ्नो मञ्जुरीबिना विवाह भएको भन्दै यादवले सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिहरूलाई पक्राउ गरी जबर्जस्ती छुटाइदिन दबाब दिएका हुन् ।

प्रहरीका अनुसार यादवकी छोरीले गरेको विवाह कानूनतः वैध छ । केटी २७ वर्षकी र केटा २३ वर्षका हुन् । जात नमिलेको र केटाको आर्थिक स्तर कमजोर रहेकाले यादवले स्वीकार नगरेको बुझिएको छ । उनले हजारौँ मानिस ल्याएर जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय घेराउ गर्ने धम्की दिएको र त्यसपछि सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा प्रहरी प्रमुखमाथि आरोप लगाएको विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ ।

एसपी खड्काले आफूविरुद्ध लगाइएका आरोप पुष्टि गर्न चुनौती दिँदै अपुष्ट सामग्री सामाजिक सञ्जालमा शेयर नगर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । घटनाबारे प्रचलित कानुनबमोजिम अघि बढ्ने उनको भनाइ छ ।

स्रोतका अनुसार रास्वपा कार्यकर्ताहरुले एसपी खड्कालाई गैरकानुनी रुपमा काम गर्न दबाब दिदैँ आएको छ । तर एसपीले अस्वीकार गर्दा उनीहरु चिढिएको अवस्था छ ।

Janakpurdham. Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) Dhanusha District President Laxmeshwor Yadav, who was upset after his daughter got married in court, has vented his anger on the police. Dissatisfied with the police not helping to arrange his daughter's marriage, he leveled several insults at the District Police Chief at a public event. At a greeting exchange program organized by the party on Sunday, he abused SP Rupesh Khadka using words like 'intruder' and 'broker'. The program was attended by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) leaders and workers, including Dhanusha Constituency No. 2 MP Ram Binod Yadav and Dhanusha Constituency No. 3 MP Manish Jha. In the video of the program, while President Yadav is criticizing the police chief, the leaders and workers present are clapping and MP Jha is laughing. Speaking to Nepal Press, President Yadav alleged that the police are registering cases based on financial transactions in ordinary disputes, even though he has not witnessed them directly. He claims that dozens of people have informed him about such incidents. "Activists are complaining to me that cases have been registered in the industry that even involve killings in domestic disputes," he said. SP Khadka, Chief of the District Police Office, Dhanusha, issued a press release on Tuesday expressing his objection to Yadav's statement. He said that the allegations made against him and the police office are objectionable, misleading and without facts. What is a marriage dispute? According to the police, 56-year-old Yadav of Bhatahi Tole, Hanspur Municipality-8, had filed a search application at the District Police Office on Asoj 17, 2083, claiming that his female family member was missing. However, when the police investigated, it was found that the woman was not missing but had left after a court marriage. The police statement states that the marriage was already formalized by the Kathmandu District Court on Asoj 20 and that she left with her husband on Asoj 25. The police had made the two parties talk directly and informed Yadav about the real situation by showing him evidence of the marriage. However, Yadav has pressured the relevant persons to arrest and forcibly release them, saying that the marriage took place without his consent. According to the police, the marriage of Yadav's daughter is legally valid. The girl is 27 years old and the boy is 23 years old. It is understood that Yadav did not accept it because of the caste mismatch and the boy's poor financial status. He threatened to bring thousands of people to surround the District Police Office and then made allegations against the police chief at a public event, the statement said. SP Khadka has challenged the police to confirm the allegations against him and urged them not to share unconfirmed content on social media. He said that the incident will be dealt with in accordance with the prevailing law. According to sources, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) workers have been pressuring SP Khadka to work illegally. But they are irritated when the SP refuses.
